# Changelog

## 0.1.0

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation.
- Added standalone two-phase simplex LP solver.
- Added mixed-integer/binary branch-and-bound.
- Added multiple binary solution enumeration using no-good constraints.
- Added sparse-triplet constraints, assignment, transportation, and 8-queens helpers.
- Added dual/reduced-cost output and strict validation tests.
